title: Building a self-improving agent: Owner Agent
why: Production Owner.com engineering report on a self-improving agent harness: Datadog traces + Owner Agent Insights online evals recommend new tools/domains, and Forge background coding agents turn failures into offline evals then ship retained harness changes (tools/skills/prompts/evals) without weight training—same class of retained non-weight loop as the morning LangChain design-agent post.
mechanism: Feedback loop: production traces scored by Insights (capability/completeness/latency/approval-rejection); Recommended Tool alerts; Forge agents convert failures into offline eval cases, propose harness fixes, gate on Buildkite; retained growth of tools/skills/domains (241 tools / 27 domains) plus tool-search and skills for context scaling
evaluation_signal: Author-reported production metrics: tens of thousands of conversations, ~30% WoW usage growth since GA; 241 tools across 27 domains by week of Oct 26; 829 merged Owner Agent PRs in 25 weeks including evals/prompts; Insights domain letter-grades and rejection rates as harness signals (illustrative Insights screenshot noted fictional)
